author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up from author: Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'm surprised by the amount of people who are interested. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k.

author: Bee (Shel)
title: Paid character and concept art for fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I'm a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I'm looking for artists to help bring it to life! I'm starting small, but this is paid work. I'm looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Author follow-up: still early in the process and actively figuring out funding, budgeting, and how to build a team; planning more Threads about the show. Contact: reply with work and rates or DM @bee.chaoticcore.
